topic: Function Pointer Callback Mechanisms for Custom Sorting
explanation: In advanced C programming, function pointers are used to implement callback mechanisms that enable flexible, customizable behaviors such as user-defined comparison functions in sorting algorithms. This technique allows passing functions as arguments, facilitating generic and reusable code patterns that adapt to different data types or comparison criteria without rewriting core logic.
keywords: Function pointer callback, Custom comparison function, C qsort comparator, Callback sort mechanism
